title: merge.py reads required checks from branch protection, and frees a dead holder's lock
why: Root cause behind waiting page item 44 (shiv, Oct 28 12:49 CDT: "are we patching rather than fixing root causes?"). Any repo with no stamp.json requiredChecks and no branch protection cannot merge at all, and a repo with both can disagree. Incident, #746, Oct 28 12:20-12:51 CDT: merge.py run from main's checkout waited on the old gates* names, which never report after the rename (31 min lost); stopped by TaskStop, it left a merge lock with 9574 s left, and the next run refused ("The holder is dead. Run: merge --unlock"). shiv reports sessions often hold merge locks wrongly.
note: Orchestrator's slug: merge-checks-from-protection. Next cloud lane, one lane, four parts. (1) merge.py already supports requiredChecks "protection" (its default, MERGE_DEFAULTS) and reads stamp.json from origin/main on purpose, so a PR cannot change its own gate; the defect is main's stamp.json pinning a copied list. Set main's .github/stamp.json merge.requiredChecks to "protection" (rule building-allow-list-is-the-constant), and make merge.py refuse a pinned list that disagrees with a non-empty protection (orchestrator's correction, 12:58 CDT). (2) merge.py stops when a named check is absent from the head after every reported check has ended, instead of waiting to the deadline. (3) Merge lock: a holder on this host whose pid is dead is taken over with a printed line, not refused; the lock is released on SIGTERM and SIGINT. (4) project-ops: adopting a repo sets protection with its required checks, so no repo starts with none. Red first on each: #746's stale names, an absent check, a dead holder, a fresh repo. Needs no answer. Port: yes, merge.py and project-ops run in every repo; item 44 (c42) stays home's stopgap. Placed ahead of c187 (triage 11, Oct 28): it stalls merges in every repo, and it cost 31 minutes today. Lands after #746 (waiting page item 46). Add (orchestrator, Oct 28 13:38 CDT): main went red when #746 was merged by GitHub's button (12:58), because merge.py rebuilds docs/records.md at merge and the button does not (lint/test_hook_catalog.py failed 3 tests). Part 1 makes main's own CI regenerate it, or fail loudly with the fix command, so a merge outside merge.py cannot leave main stale. Shiv granted batch 12's merge with --base-red-ok in chat at 13:37 CDT. Doing: lane 013NEJL36vFx, Oct 28 13:00 CDT. Merged in batch 13, PR #787 (main 60216ac9), Oct 28 16:22 CDT (lane PR #781). Done.
